description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Hadrian builds autonomous manufacturing systems for aerospace and defense companies. The Product Engineer owns software products across discovery, design, development, launch, and operation, working directly with manufacturing users to solve operational problems.
All Levels Product Engineer owning end-to-end product areas, building full-stack software and defining architecture from user discovery.

Responsibilities:
• Build and ship full stack products. Take software from an empty repo to production, with real users who depend on it
• Own a product area end to end. Stay on it from the first unclear conversation through design, build, launch, and iteration
• Make and document the technical calls. Choose the architecture, data models, and tradeoffs, and write them down for other engineers
• Do your own discovery. Talk to users, watch how they work, and find the real problem behind the request
• Ship fast, keep quality high, and feed the platform. Get working software to users early, keep code readable and tested, and bring requirements back to the core platform

Requirements:
• Deep software engineering experience
• You've shipped full stack applications, worked in large codebases, and tech led critical projects
• Strong system design skills
• You design services, APIs, and data models that hold up as usage grows
• Extreme product intuition and a 0-to-1 track record
• You think as hard about what to build as how to build it, and you're comfortable shipping in unclear environments
• Direct work with users, and clear communication
• You turn customer needs into shipped software, explain tradeoffs to any audience, and push back when the ask doesn't match the problem
• AI native, with a bias to action
• You use AI across your whole workflow, can show how it makes you much faster, and care more about the right solution than being right
• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State

Preferred:
• Founder or founding engineer experience
• You've taken a new product from 0 to 1
• Product ownership without a PM
• You've owned a product area, or worked as an engineer and PM hybrid
• Operations tooling
• You've built workflow tools or data heavy applications for operations teams
• Forward deployed experience
• You've done forward deployed, solutions engineering, or technical consulting work built against messy customer reality
• A visible body of work
• A strong GitHub presence or projects shipped outside of work
